_note: T1.5 graphics packs of Phantasie I. A pack is offered only when its original files (extracts) are present. default_order: the packs that may become the default, first available wins (Amiga; user 2026-10-25). DOS CGA is never drawn by default: it has auto_select false and is not listed in default_order; only an explicit choice (the later T5 option) selects it. fallback_order (user, s158): when no default_order pack is present (a DOS-only import), the first available of these is drawn, so art follows what was imported.
